test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

L ≤ R Q ≥ T

Conclusions:

I. N ≥ M

II. Q ≤ R

III. M > L

IV. N ≥ L

options.text: All conclusions I, II, III and IV follow
Only conclusions I and IV follow
Only conclusions III and IV follow

solution:
**__Given statement__:**

L ≤ R Q ≥ T

**__Conclusions__:**

I. N ≥ M → False 

We have M ≥ Q and N > Q ⇒ N > Q ≤ M

so **relation between M and N cannot be determined.**

II. Q ≤
